item.title: Her Stalker Paid $250 To Find Her Front Door
item.description: Robert Bardo paid a private investigator to find actress Rebecca Schaeffer’s address through DMV records. He killed the 21-year-old at her Los Angeles home in 1989. Convicted of first-degree murder in 1991, he received life without parole.

item.title: She Killed The Friends Who Helped Her Fit In
item.description: Christine Paolilla was 17 when she participated in four killings in Clear Lake, Texas, including those of two friends who had helped her fit in at school. An anonymous tip broke the case three years later. In 2008, she was convicted of capital murder and sentenced to life.

item.title: The INCEST COUPLE Who Committed the UNTHINKABLE – McNabb & Bell
item.description: Christopher McNabb and Cortney Bell were convicted in 2019 after their newborn daughter, Caliyah, was found dead near their Georgia home. McNabb received life without parole. By 2023, courts had overturned all three of Bell’s convictions for insufficient evidence.

item.title: Her Neighbor’s Camera Captured What She Claimed To Forget
item.description: Cosplay model Melissa Turner initially claimed she couldn’t remember an argument with fiancé Matthew Trussler. A neighbor’s camera recorded it. Jurors rejected her self-defense claim, convicting her of second-degree murder in 2022. She received 20½ years in prison.

item.title: She Made Unrelated Children Believe They Were Siblings
item.description: Australian cult leader Anne Hamilton-Byrne raised children in The Family to believe she was their birth mother, bleaching their hair and dressing them alike. Police rescued children in 1987, but she was never charged with abuse and received an A$5,000 fine for falsifying documents.

item.title: She Tried To Kill Him. Then She Cross-Examined Him
item.description: Sheila Davalloo’s husband survived her 2003 attack during a blindfolded guessing game. Years later, she represented herself and questioned him at her trial for killing romantic rival Anna Lisa Raymundo. Her convictions brought consecutive prison sentences totaling 75 years.
